{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}It's just not like me to buy
stuff because it's there, or
because everyone else is.
{07 14 00}I don't do things because
everyone else is doing it.{01 00 00 0a 00}
I dance to my own beat!

{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Mulle pole omane osta asju
sellepärast, et need on
olemas või teised ostavad.
{07 14 00}Ma ei tee asju sellepärast,
et teised neid teevad.{01 00 00 0a 00}
Ma tantsin oma rütmi järgi!

{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 14 00}You can collect stuff or

want to{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 15 00}But never lose sight of{01 00 00 0a 00}

messages.en:
{07 16 00}How come you always look
down when you walk,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}You know, you can change 
the way you feel by
changing the way you walk.
{07 19 00}So it's especially important
to keep that chin up when 
you're blue, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}{07 00 00}!

{07 16 00}Miks sa vaatad kõndides
alati alla,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Tead, sa saad muuta seda,
kuidas end tunned, kui
muudad oma kõnnakut.
{07 19 00}Nii et eriti tähtis on
hoida lõug püsti, kui
oled kurb, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}{07 00 00}!

Kurb.

to work to make ends meet
{07 19 00}just wouldn't understand.{07 00 00}
